lp_intro: Select products and send labels to the printer configured in Panel.
lp_failed: The operation was not confirmed. Check history or retry without changing the data.
lp_shift: Select an employee before requesting labels.
lp_no_printer: No printing POS is selected in Panel. Requests will wait.
lp_invalid: Enter a valid count (max. 300 per line, 1000 total).
lp_confirm_reprint: The previous print may already have completed. Print these same labels again?
lp_status_blocked: Printing blocked — check product data or label count
